skill.name: plan-feature
skill.description: Creates structured feature plans by gathering requirements, analyzing codebase patterns, and saving implementation tasks for approval.
skill.summary: Plan coding features with requirements, architecture notes, tasks, risks, and approval checkpoints.

content.value_statement: Feature work often starts with unclear scope, hidden risks, and scattered tasks. This skill creates an approval-ready plan before implementation begins.
actual_capabilities: Gathers feature goals, acceptance criteria, and open questions before planning.
Analyzes related code paths, existing patterns, and integration points.
Organizes backend, frontend, and cross-cutting work into testable tasks.
Captures architecture decisions, risks, affected modules, and verification steps.
Saves a persistent Markdown plan under .claude/plans for later review.
limitations: It produces a plan and does not implement code without later user approval.
Plan quality depends on the detail of the feature request and repository context.
It uses a fixed Markdown structure that may need adaptation for some teams.
It does not estimate dates, staffing, or budget commitments.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Product Feature
use_cases.description: Turn a rough feature idea into scope, decisions, tasks, risks, and questions before development starts.

use_cases.title: Review Architecture Impact
use_cases.description: Map a requested change across API, domain, adapter, and UI layers before assigning implementation work.

use_cases.title: Create Team Handoff Plans
use_cases.description: Save a structured plan that teammates can review, approve, and use during later implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Simple Feature
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a clear goal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use plan-feature to plan adding [feature name]. Include acceptance criteria, affected files, tasks, risks, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an Existing Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use plan-feature for [feature name]. First inspect the existing flow, then propose integration points and a task breakdown.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Design Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use plan-feature to plan [feature name]. Compare major design options, choose one, and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Approval Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use plan-feature for [feature name]. Produce an approval-ready plan with module impact, sequencing, validation, risks, and unresolved decisions.

output_examples.input: Plan a customizable voting deck feature for an estimation app.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a saved feature plan with a summary, affected modules, design decisions, ordered tasks, risks, and open questions.

output_examples.input: Plan user authentication for an existing web application.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies API, UI, storage, validation, testing, and migration work before asking for implementation approval.

output_examples.input: Plan a fix for unreliable session timers.
output_examples.output: The skill narrows the problem, lists likely integration points, separates investigation from changes, and records verification steps.

best_practices: Provide the feature goal, target users, known constraints, and acceptance criteria before invoking the skill.
Review the saved plan for scope, sequencing, and open questions before implementation begins.
Update the plan when major decisions change so future work uses the latest context.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the generated plan as approval to implement code immediately.
Do not skip repository analysis when the feature touches existing behavior.
Do not leave broad tasks unbroken when they span multiple modules or risk areas.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: No. It creates a structured implementation plan and waits for user approval before any coding work starts.

faq.question: Where are plans saved?
faq.answer: Plans are saved as Markdown files in the .claude/plans directory using a slug based on the feature name.

faq.question: Can it work with frontend and backend features?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes sections for backend, frontend, shared contracts, tests, documentation, and verification work.

faq.question: Does it ask clarifying questions?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions tell the assistant to ask questions when requirements, scope, or acceptance criteria are unclear.

faq.question: Can teams review the output?
faq.answer: Yes. The saved Markdown file is intended as a persistent plan for approval, handoff, and later reference.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
